verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; Google spend is being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 125 leads, all driven by Meta — but this past week leads fell 49% versus the week before, caused by a spend pullback that included at least one zero-spend day on September 17, which pushed cost per lead up 38%. Separately, Google Ads consumed $485 over the 28-day window and produced zero leads; that budget is being redirected so it stops draining without return. Meta delivery will be stabilised with consistent daily spend to prevent the efficiency swings seen this week. Next period you should see a steadier lead volume and a lower cost per lead as Meta runs without interruption and the Google budget is put to work elsewhere.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, every one from Meta
cost per lead over 28 days — spiking this week due to a zero-spend day
spent on Google Ads this period with zero leads returned

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has spent $485 this period with no leads and very little traffic — it is a confirmed budget leak.
watch_item.fix: That campaign is being paused or restructured this week so the budget is redirected to channels that are producing results.
